spanish: Cuando compres siervo hebreo, seis años servirá, y en el séptimo saldrá a libre, gratis.
grammarChanges: Removed the unmarked smoothing "de" before "gratis"; חָפְשִׁי and חִנָּם are two separate adverbial tokens with no Hebrew connector between them, so "de" added a link not present in the source. A comma now separates the two adverbials for Spanish flow.
